processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave permission in selling 'araya by their estimation in what is less than five wasqs, or in five wasqs - Dawud doubted - he said: five wasqs or less than five wasqs. Malik said: The 'araya are only sold by their estimation of dates, this is approximated and estimated in the tops of palm trees, and permission was given for it because it was placed in the category of tawliyah, iqalah, and partnership. Had it been like other sales, no one would share anyone else in his food until the buyer takes possession of it.

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by 'Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman: A man bought the fruit of a garden in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he worked on it and took care of it until the loss became clear to him. So he asked the owner of the garden to reduce (the price) for him or to cancel (the sale). But he swore not to do so. Then the mother of the buyer went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and mentioned that to him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'He swore not to do good.' The owner of the garden heard about that, so he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, it is his.'

processed_hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي /22 يَحْيَى /22 ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 أَبِي الرِّجَالِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ L7065 /94 ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ /26 عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ L6058 /26 ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهَا تَقُولُ : /27 ابْتَاعَ رَجُلٌ ثَمَرَ حَائِطٍ فِي زَمَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَعَالَجَهُ وَقَامَ فِيهِ حَتَّى تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ النُّقْصَانُ ، فَسَأَلَ رَبَّ الْحَائِطِ أَنْ يَضَعَ لَهُ أَوْ أَنْ يُقِيلَهُ ، فَحَلَفَ أَنْ لَا يَفْعَلَ ، فَذَهَبَتْ أُمُّ الْمُشْتَرِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : /20 " تَأَلَّى أَنْ لَا يَفْعَلَ خَيْرًا " . فَسَمِعَ بِذَلِكَ رَبُّ الْحَائِطِ ، فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، هُوَ لَهُ /27 *

processed_hadiths.english_translation: From Abu Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abd al-Rahman: He used to sell the fruit of his garden and make an exception from it. And from Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr: That his grandfather Muhammad ibn 'Amr ibn Hazm sold the fruit of a garden of his called al-Afraq for four thousand dirhams, and he made an exception from it for eight hundred dirhams worth of dates. And from Abu al-Rijal Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Harithah: That his mother 'Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman used to sell her fruits and make an exception from them. Malik said: The agreed-upon matter among us is that when a man sells the fruit of his garden, he may make an exception from the fruit of his garden of what is between him and a third of the fruit, not exceeding that. And whatever is less than a third, there is no harm in that. Malik said: As for the man who sells the fruit of his garden and excepts from the fruit of his garden the fruit of a palm tree or palm trees which he chooses and names their number, I see no harm in that, because the owner of the garden only excepted something from the fruit of his own garden, and that is only something he withheld from his garden and kept for himself and did not sell, and he sold from his garden what was other than that.

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by 'Ata' ibn Yasar: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Dates for dates, like for like.' Then it was said to him: 'Indeed, your governor over Khaybar takes one sa' for two sa's.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Call him to me.' So he was called to him. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: 'Do you take one sa' for two sa's?' He said: 'O Messenger of Allah, they do not sell me the janib (high quality dates) for the jam' (mixed quality dates) sa' for sa'.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: 'Sell the jam' for dirhams, then buy with the dirhams janib.'

processed_hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي /22 يَحْيَى /22 ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ L3122 /94 ، عَنْ /26 عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ L5640 /26 ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : /27 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : /20 " التَّمْرُ بِالتَّمْرِ مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ " . فَقِيلَ لَهُ : إِنَّ عَامِلَكَ عَلَى /60 خَيْبَرَ /60 يَأْخُذُ الصَّاعَ بِالصَّاعَيْنِ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " ادْعُوهُ لِي " . فَدُعِيَ لَهُ ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَتَأْخُذُ الصَّاعَ بِالصَّاعَيْنِ ؟ " فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، لَا يَبِيعُونَنِي الْجَنِيبَ بِالْجَمْعِ صَاعًا بِصَاعٍ . فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " بِعِ الْجَمْعَ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ ثُمَّ ابْتَعْ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ جَنِيبًا " /27 *

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and Abu Hurayrah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ employed a man over Khaybar, and he came to him with janib dates. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: 'Are all the dates of Khaybar like this?' He said: 'No, by Allah, O Messenger of Allah. Indeed, we take one sa' of this for two sa's, and two sa's for three.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Do not do that. Sell the jam' for dirhams, then buy with the dirhams janib.'

processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 عَبْدِ الْحَميدِ بْنِ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ L5183 /94 ، عَنْ /26 سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ L3299 /26 ، /27 عَنْ /93 أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ L3260 /93 ، وَعَنْ /15 /93 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ L4396 /93 /15 ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ اسْتَعْمَلَ رَجُلًا عَلَى /60 خَيْبَرَ /60 فَجَاءَهُ بِتَمْرٍ جَنِيبٍ ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَكُلُّ تَمْرِ /60 خَيْبَرَ /60 هَكَذَا ؟ " فَقَالَ : لَا وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، إِنَّا لَنَأْخُذُ الصَّاعَ مِنْ هَذَا بِالصَّاعَيْنِ ، وَالصَّاعَيْنِ بِالثَّلَاثَةِ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : /20 " لَا تَفْعَلْ ، بِعِ الْجَمْعَ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ ، ثُمَّ ابْتَعْ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ جَنِيبًا " /27 *

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas: From Abdullah ibn Yazid that Zayd Abu 'Ayyash informed him that he asked Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas about (exchanging) al-bayda' (white wheat) for al-sult (barley). Sa'd said to him: 'Which of them is better?' He said: 'Al-bayda'.' So he forbade him from that. And Sa'd said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ being asked about buying dates with fresh dates. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Does the fresh date decrease when it dries?' They said: 'Yes.' So he forbade that.
